nodes.name: configure-tls-port.md
nodes.summary: Quick-fix note describing how to enable HTTPS on port 3001 for local development by adding HTTPS=true to .env.development alongside the existing PORT=3001 setting.

nodes.name: fix-menu-path-error.md
nodes.summary: Quick-fix note for a startup TypeError in App.tsx caused by a mismatch between the 'rate-plan' key in menuOrder and the 'ratePlan' key in the menus object, resolved by aligning the keys and adding a safety filter in filterMenus.

nodes.name: fix-rate-plan-visibility.md
nodes.summary: Quick-fix note explaining why the Rate Plan menu item was hidden due to a camelCase/kebab-case mismatch between the 'ratePlan' menu key and the backend-provided 'rate-plan' authority string, fixed by standardizing on 'rate-plan' throughout App.tsx.

nodes.name: fix-room-preselection.md
nodes.summary: Quick-fix note for InvoiceEditor's chooseRoom function, which failed to pre-select rooms in the modal because it matched invoice.rooms values against room.name instead of the correct room.internalName field.

nodes.name: rename-room-to-ts.md
nodes.summary: Quick-fix note documenting the rename of src/db/room.tsx to src/db/room.ts, since the file no longer contains JSX and a .ts extension better reflects its pure TypeScript content.
